title: What if your dropped ball ends up back in the same spot?
question: You drop your ball for relief but it rolls back to the same tough place as before. What can you do next?

choices.text: Play the ball as it is, or declare it unplayable again
Move the ball to an easier spot without penalty
Pick up the ball and stop playing the hole

explanation: You must play the ball as it lies, or you may declare it unplayable again and take another penalty stroke.
imagePrompt: A teenage boy golfer has dropped his ball and watches as it rolls back under the same tree roots, looking frustrated.
imageAlt: Teen golfer drops a ball and it returns to a tough spot under tree roots.
